returns — How investments performed over a window (default: since the first snapshot), as twr and mwr %, after fees and taxes. view=global: the whole portfolio. sources, portfolios: per entity, best-effort. accounts: per account, exact. stated: a document's stated periods beside the engine's figures; it takes no method, period, annualize, netting, inception, benchmark or currency. bridge: why net worth moved, for the whole household: end_net_worth = start_net_worth + net_saved + onboarded + gain; whole months; it takes no method, annualize, netting, inception, benchmark, source or account. private: each private equity or private debt holding (fund, SPV, private stock, note) since its first call, to the latest snapshot or as_of: asset_class, vehicle, status, paid_in, distributed, nav, marked_at, dpi, tvpi, irr_pct, then the total; it takes no method, period, annualize, netting, inception, benchmark, from or to. One row per entity for the whole window unless period adds buckets. quality names the reason for every n/a. Example: {view: "accounts", from: "2025", to: "2025"}.

Parameters (all optional):
  from         Window start; snaps to the unit's start.
  to           Window end; snaps to the unit's end. Default today unless the tool says otherwise.
  view         global | sources | portfolios | accounts | stated | bridge | private. Grain (default global); stated, bridge and private are side views.
  method       twr | mwr | both. twr, mwr or both (default both).
  period       monthly | quarterly | annual | total. Bucket size (default total: one row per entity for the whole window).
  annualize    auto | always | never. auto (default; only spans of a year or more), always, never.
  netting      Net internal transfers at coarse grains (default true).
  inception    full | strict. full (default) or strict.
  benchmark    view=global only: the benchmark beside each row, over the days both sides have. One of Global 60/40, Global 80/20, S&P 500, US total bond market, World (ACWI), or a name from the config's benchmarks block.
  as_of        private only: the day the view reads (default: the latest snapshot).
  source       Keep this source id only (e.g. "schwab"); a comma list keeps several.
  account      Keep rows whose account name, id or nickname contains this (case-insensitive).
  asset_class  private only: keep only this asset class (private_equity or private_debt).
  currency     Output currency, e.g. USD or CHF. Default: the configured one.
  filter       Conditions, all of which hold: ["value > 1000", "date >= 2025-07", "category not in Rent, Groceries"].
  search       Keep rows with this text in any cell.
  columns      "default", "all", names, or "+add,-remove"; describe(topic=<tool>) lists them.
  sort         Column to sort by; "-" for descending. "-value": the main money column, largest first whatever the sign.
  max_chars    Most characters the result may take (default 16000); the page ends at a row boundary and the last line says how to get the rest.
  limit        Most rows to return (default: as many as fit).
  offset       Rows to skip (default 0).
  format       table | csv | json. Result format (default table).

Columns (* = shown by default; columns=all shows every one):
  global: silver_source*, entity*, entity_id, period*, start_date, end_date, start_USD*, end_USD*, net_flow_USD*, gain_USD*, twr_pct*, twr_ann_pct, mwr_pct*, mwr_ann_pct, benchmark_twr_pct, compared_twr_pct, excess_pct, benchmark_mwr_pct, compared_mwr_pct, compared_from, compared_to, benchmark_quality, quality*
  sources: silver_source*, entity*, entity_id, period*, start_date, end_date, start_USD*, end_USD*, net_flow_USD*, gain_USD*, twr_pct*, twr_ann_pct, mwr_pct*, mwr_ann_pct, benchmark_twr_pct, compared_twr_pct, excess_pct, benchmark_mwr_pct, compared_mwr_pct, compared_from, compared_to, benchmark_quality, quality*
  portfolios: silver_source*, entity*, entity_id, period*, start_date, end_date, start_USD*, end_USD*, net_flow_USD*, gain_USD*, twr_pct*, twr_ann_pct, mwr_pct*, mwr_ann_pct, benchmark_twr_pct, compared_twr_pct, excess_pct, benchmark_mwr_pct, compared_mwr_pct, compared_from, compared_to, benchmark_quality, quality*
  accounts: silver_source*, entity*, entity_id, period*, start_date, end_date, start_USD*, end_USD*, net_flow_USD*, gain_USD*, twr_pct*, twr_ann_pct, mwr_pct*, mwr_ann_pct, benchmark_twr_pct, compared_twr_pct, excess_pct, benchmark_mwr_pct, compared_mwr_pct, compared_from, compared_to, benchmark_quality, quality*
  stated: silver_source*, account*, account_id, period*, start_date, end_date, currency*, stated_beginning, stated_ending*, stated_accrual, stated_net_additions*, stated_net_gain, stated_income, stated_fees, start_value, end_value*, net_flow*, flow_gap*, value_gap*, document, quality*
  bridge: period*, start_date, end_date, start_net_worth_USD*, net_saved_USD*, onboarded_USD*, gain_USD*, end_net_worth_USD*, net_flow_USD, debt_repaid_USD, bridge_gap_USD, quality*
  private: silver_source*, account*, account_id, holding*, holding_id, asset_class*, vehicle*, status*, first_call*, paid_in_USD*, commitment_USD*, unfunded_USD*, distributed_USD*, nav_USD*, marked_at*, end_date, dpi*, tvpi*, irr_pct*, stated_tvpi, stated_dpi, stated_as_of, quality*

Filters each view takes (a filter the view lacks moves the call to the first finer view that has it):
  global: none
  sources: source
  portfolios: source
  accounts: source, account
Outside that order (a view of its own, which no filter moves a call to or from):
  stated: source, account
  bridge: none
  private: source, account, asset_class

The quality column explains every n/a (describe topic=quality). accounts is exact; the coarser views are best-effort, and returns do not add up across views. stated sets each period a document states for an account (stated net additions, ending value) against the engine's monthly figures for it, in the stated currency; flow_gap and value_gap are the differences. bridge explains net worth: end_net_worth = start_net_worth + net_saved + onboarded + gain. net_saved = net_flow + debt_repaid, onboarded is value that entered or left tracking, gain is the residual, returns' gain plus the FX move on debt. It reads whole months for the whole household. private: dpi = distributed / paid_in, tvpi = (distributed + nav) / paid_in; irr_pct is the money-weighted return since the first call; status is held, partially_exited or exited. Marks are old by nature, so read marked_at.
Example: {view: "sources", from: "2024", to: "2025", period: "annual", method: "twr"}.

This endpoint redacts amounts, quantities, account numbers and the names taken off statements (merchants, payers, narratives), and shows a name a person typed about an account as a pseudonym such as manual-1, or as its account number, redacted; source ids, other account names, holdings and their names, categories and shares stay visible.
